summary: Definium Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, announcing via press release that the FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy designation to its DT120 (lysergide) orally disintegrating tablet for major depressive disorder. The designation follows positive Phase 3 Emerge data showing a single 100 microgram dose produced an 8.1-point placebo-adjusted MADRS improvement at Week 6 (p<0.0001), durable through Week 12. This is the second such designation for DT120, the first covering generalized anxiety disorder. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is involved; a routine regulatory milestone, not a special situation.
